purpose: Current DANTE operational projection that blocks outbound Auth/security email to recipients with confirmed hard-bounce or complaint evidence, without redefining EmailIdentity canonical meaning.

columns.name: email_recipient_suppression_ref
columns.meaning: Stable UUIDv7 identity of the suppression projection row.

columns.name: recipient_comparison_key
columns.meaning: Normalized email recipient identity governed by this operational suppression.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.meaning: Reviewed suppression reason: hard bounce or complaint.

columns.name: source_provider_event_ref
columns.meaning: Provider observation that currently justifies the suppression projection.

columns.name: suppressed_at
columns.meaning: Provider observation instant that established or refreshed suppression.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Last DANTE update instant for the current suppression projection.

columns.name: cleared_at
columns.meaning: Optional instant the operational suppression was explicitly cleared.

foreign_keys.name: fk_email_recipient_suppression_source_event
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Every active suppression must remain traceable to normalized provider evidence.

unique_constraints.name: uq_email_recipient_suppression_recipient
unique_constraints.reason: Maintain exactly one current suppression projection per normalized recipient.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_recipient_suppression_uuidv7
check_constraints.reason: Require stable UUIDv7 identity without treating it as chronology authority.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_recipient_suppression_reason_code
check_constraints.reason: Suppress only on reviewed strong provider signals, not soft/transient delivery problems.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_recipient_suppression_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(suppressed_at) AND isfinite(updated_at) AND updated_at >= suppressed_at AND (cleared_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(cleared_at) AND cleared_at >= suppressed_at))

indexes.name: uq_email_recipient_suppression_recipient
indexes.reason: Fast current suppression lookup and uniqueness enforcement.

state_history.current_binding: Current operational suppression is derived from provider evidence and remains distinct from canonical email ownership, verification and Account status.
state_history.chronology: suppressed_at tracks evidence chronology while updated_at/cleared_at track DANTE projection lifecycle.
state_history.immutability_policy: Recipient identity is immutable; reason/source/timestamps may change only through the reviewed suppression lifecycle.

lifecycle.retention: Retained while needed to prevent known-invalid or complained-of delivery and according to Auth/security retention policy.
lifecycle.redaction: Contains normalized recipient identity but no email message content, OTP, recovery proof or raw provider payload.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; explicit clearing uses cleared_at so prior suppression state is not silently erased.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL hard-bounce/complaint suppression, duplicate feedback and future-claim blocking proof.
